standard.coverage: All covered employers. The highest general minimum wage of any US state-level jurisdiction.
standard.note: D.C. Code 32-1003 annual CPI-W adjustment every July 1. A January-only refresh cycle carries a stale DC rate for half the year.

tipped.note: Initiative 82's tip-credit phase-out was RE-CUT by the Council in 2025: instead of eliminating the tip credit outright, the tipped wage is now a PERCENTAGE of the full minimum wage -- frozen at $10.00 through 2026-06-30, then 56% of the minimum wage from 2026-07-01 (56% of $18.40 = $10.304, published as $10.30), 60% from 2028-07-01, and +5 points every two years thereafter to a 75% cap on 2034-07-01.

scheduledChanges.note: Next step of the amended Initiative 82 schedule; the standard rate continues to index each July 1.

sources.title: DC Department of Employment Services, Office of Wage and Hour -- District of Columbia Minimum Wage Increase (public notice)
sources.verifiedBy: PDF downloaded and its text extracted directly this session (WebFetch's own conversion returned only binary noise; decompressing the PDF's content streams and pulling the text-showing operators worked). Quoted: 'Beginning July 1, 2026, the minimum wage in the District of Columbia will increase ... from $17.95 per hour to $18.40 per hour for all workers, regardless of size of employer' and 'As of July 1, 2026, the base minimum wage for tipped employees will increase from $10.00 per hour to $10.30.' Also confirms the pre-2026-07-01 figures ($17.95 standard, $10.00 tipped), now carried as historicalPredecessorOf entries.

knownGaps: DC's own 'living wage' for government contractors and recipients of city assistance is a separate, higher figure not carried here.
